## Objective

Single Core reader for the companion event journal

## Mode/Slice Decision

- scope_reason: bounded_structured_slice: one coherent outcome (a single Core journal reader feeding both companions) inside the companion module family. quick_task is ineligible because the runtime/host contract of run-view changes (optional input, additive output) and two hosts change visibly, so design decisions must be fixed in SD before implementation; verified_change is ineligible (several owners, CLI interface change). No full-depth trigger: the run-view change is additive and backward compatible with consumers only in this repository and the same plugin build, no persistence/authority/rollout boundary, failure stays local. Rejected alternative: structured_delivery. Required next gate: PRD.
